title: Buddy rebuild — round 4: the summary row, and the pill whose words appear

steps.path: The line under a reply that did more than talk
steps.headline: The summary line is now a full-width row drawn like the small pill: rounded ends, the pill's colour and height, the words kept.
steps.changed: One row across the bubble with fully rounded ends, the darker pill colour and a thin outline, the pill's small height and text, a tick (or a spinner while working) at the left and an arrow at the right.
steps.notice: Pressing it opens the steps and files in place, as before.

steps.headline: The four buttons as one pill, with their words appearing when you point. Which way should the words appear?
steps.notice: Each design shows the pill resting, then with the pointer on the second button (Bigger window). Words now say more: Screenshot desktop, Bigger window, Open YouCoded, Hide until restart. Pointing at a button also gives your computer's own tooltip after a moment.

variants.label: One grows
variants.summary: Only the button you point at widens to show its words; the pill grows to the right smoothly and shrinks back when you move away.
variants.risk: The buttons after it slide right while you point, so moving along the row shifts things under the pointer.

variants.label: All open
variants.summary: Pointing anywhere at the pill opens every button's words at once, so you read all four, then it folds back.
variants.risk: Opened it is about 630 px wide, wider than the chat, so he needs that much free room beside him.

variants.label: Caption below
variants.summary: The pill never changes size; a small caption appears under the button you point at.
variants.risk: Nothing moves, but the words are smaller and sit below the pill.
